marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Park Soo-ha (played by Lee Jong-seok) is a special high school boy: he can read other people's mind. He got this ability at the age ogf 9, after seeing his father getting murdered in a car crash. However, this accident is not just any car crash - it was done on purpose by Min Joon-guk (played by Jung Woong-in). janh Hye-sung (played by Lee Bo-yeong) then a 18 year old high school girl, bravely steps up out in court as the witness of the murder, although she was previously threatened by the killer not to tell anyone...
